people.name: Ahikam
people.line: Son of Shaphan, protected Jeremiah from death

people.name: Baruch
people.line: Jeremiah's scribe who recorded and delivered his prophecies.

people.name: Gedaliah
people.line: Appointed governor of Judah by Babylonians; assassinated by Ishmael.

people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

people.name: Nebuzaradan
people.line: Babylonian captain of the guard during Jerusalem's fall.

people.name: Shaphan
people.line: Scribe during the reign of King Josiah

translations.web: the men, and the women, and the children, and the king’s daughters, and every person who Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had left with Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan; and Jeremiah the prophet, and Baruch the son of Neriah;
translations.bsb: the men, the women, the children, the king’s daughters, and everyone whom Nebuzaradan captain of the guard had allowed to remain with Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, as well as Jeremiah the prophet and Baruch son of Neriah.
translations.kjv: Even men, and women, and children, and the king's daughters, and every person that Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had left with Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Jeremiah the prophet, and Baruch the son of Neriah.
